# `mise settings unset`

- **用法：** `mise settings unset [-l --local] <KEY>`
- **别名：** `rm`、`remove`、`delete`、`del`
- **作用：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/settings/unset.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/settings/unset.rs)

Remove a setting from the global or project config

Edits ~/.config/mise/config.toml, or the nearest project config with
`--local`. The setting then falls back to its default or to a value from
another config file.

## 参数
- **`<KEY>`** — 要移除的设置

## Flags
- **`-l --local`** — Write to the nearest project config instead of the global config

  The nearest project config is the lowest-precedence TOML file in the nearest directory that has one, or ./mise.toml.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## 示例

Remove jobs from the global config

```
mise settings unset jobs
```
